name: Candid Health

lifecycle.notes: Site moved from joincandidhealth.com to candidhealth.com; support and API docs remain on joincandidhealth.com subdomains.

short_description: Revenue cycle automation for growing provider organizations: a payer rules engine fixes claims before submission, with APIs, claim-level reporting and A/R automation.
long_description: Candid Health sells revenue cycle automation to provider organizations rather than to individual clinicians. Its platform tracks claims end to end and runs them through a rules engine, kept current with payer requirements, that corrects issues such as missing credentials and formatting errors before submission; Candid says its top customers reach a 95 to 99% payer net collection rate. It connects to an organization's existing EHR and custom systems through APIs, offers near-real-time claim-level reporting and a claims data export (Candid Data Share), and handles patient invoicing once payer adjudication is complete. Published customer stories include Talkiatry, a national psychiatry group that employs its clinicians and contracts with hundreds of insurers, and Tia, whose model includes mental health. Pricing is not published; organizations contact sales. Candid signs business associate agreements with customers and has announced SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2 examinations.
one_liner: Claims automation and RCM infrastructure for fast-growing provider organizations, sold through sales.
best_for: Multi-state telehealth and psychiatry groups billing many payers at volume
Organizations with engineering staff who want to drive billing through an API
Revenue cycle teams that want claim-level reporting and rules-based fixes before submission
Organizations that need a vendor with a SOC 2 Type 2 report and a BAA
not_for: Solo clinicians and small practices; Candid is sold to organizations
Practices looking for an EHR with billing built in; Candid connects to the EHR you already use
